SELECT TOP (100) [Id]
      ,[Version]
      ,[Status]
      ,[PartyType]
      ,[EntityType]
      ,[EntitySubType]
      ,[EntityTitle]
      ,[TaxIdentifierType]
      ,[EntityCreatedDate]
      ,[IndividualFirstName]
      ,[IndividualMiddleName]
      ,[IndividualLastName]
      ,[IndividualSuffix]
      ,[IndividualDateOfBirth]
      ,[IndividualCitizenship]
      ,[IndividualMaritalStatus]
      ,[Addresses]
      ,[Contacts]
      ,[Identifiers]
      ,[IsDeceased]
      ,[DateOfDeath]
      ,[PIIId]
      ,[CreatedDate]
      ,[UpdatedDate]
      ,[CreatedBy]
      ,[UpdatedBy]
      ,[IsDeleted]
  FROM [dbo].[Party]
